prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent sixteen-pose animation atlas for Crown & Kingdoms, a hand-painted medieval isometric RTS. Reference image supplies the main subject's identity/materials only; ignore neighboring fragments/background. 1536x1024 landscape, strict four columns by four rows, sixteen complete consistent copies of the same subject in sequential animation poses. Fixed 3/4 isometric view facing right, upper-left warm daylight, realistic painted wood/cloth/metal, blue team cloth for recolouring, neutral natural materials. True transparent background, no grid/labels/terrain squares, complete entire silhouette inside EACH cell with generous margins and no overlaps. Top two rows frames0-7: eight distinct sequential movement poses. Bottom two rows frames8-15: eight activity poses, frame8 ready idle, frames9-11 prepare, frame12 main activity, frames13-15 recover, then loop. Keep proportions, equipment, subject identity and lighting consistent. No extra weapons, limbs, floating parts, modern items, pixel art or icons. Subject: original small wooden FISHING BOAT, one blue-clothed fisherman, short mast and simple angled boom with fishing net. Boat bow points right, stern left. Movement sequence: gentle pitch/roll, fisherman rows with one attached oar, net stowed, hull shape consistent. Activity sequence: fisherman lowers attached net beside hull, draws it up with a small visible fish catch at frame12, brings net aboard, returns to ready. Preserve entire net/boom/hull, subtle transparent blue water ripples immediately by hull only, NO water rectangle or ground shadow. No sails, cannon or weapon. Hull width about 250px, height under 190px per cell.

transportLayoutEdit.reason: First transport source had three vertically touching silhouettes; rejected before atlas packing.
transportLayoutEdit.prompt: Edit this original transport ship sixteen-pose animation sheet. Preserve the exact vessel, cream sail, blue pennant, wood and blue crew and pose sequence. Correct ONLY the layout: keep 1536x1024 and strict FOUR columns by FOUR rows. Scale each of the sixteen entire ship poses down to 80 percent of its current size, centered separately inside its own 384x256 pixel cell, including sail/mast/rigging/ladder/waterline. Require at least 20 fully transparent pixels above and below EVERY complete ship and 25 pixels at left/right, so no pixels from one pose can touch another pose. True fully transparent background with zero alpha between poses, no backdrop or grid. Top eight sailing poses, bottom eight boarding-ladder activity poses. No cropping, no overlaps, no labels. All16 full ships.
